title: PolyKernel tuning cache (Pinned contract H, AUTHORITATIVE)
description: Versioned-envelope tuning cache mapping (gpu, op, shape) to the best autotuner config, its score, and per-variant correctness metrics. Implemented by lib/Autotune/TuningCache.cpp (Todo 24). Parse-don't-validate: a missing or wrong-typed required field is a schema error, never a silent default. time_ms is the only nullable field (null when scored by a compile-time model rather than measured). Field names are PINNED - do not rename.

version.description: Envelope schema version. Currently 1 (kTuningCacheVersion). A parser rejects any other version.

entries.description: One object per tuned (gpu, op, shape).

gpu.description: Target GPU identity, part of the cache key (e.g. "sm_90", "gfx942").

op.description: Op name, part of the cache key (e.g. "matmul").

time_ms.description: Measured wall time in milliseconds. REQUIRED key; null iff scored_by == "compile_time_model".

validated.description: True iff this variant passed the correctness gate against the golden (contract C).

shape.description: The problem shape, part of the cache key.

config.description: The winning autotuner config (include/PolyKernel/Autotune/ConfigSpace.h Config). Field names match the config-space axes exactly.

correctness.description: Per-variant correctness metrics vs the golden. The bench (Todo 25) gates on the contract-C thresholds: cosine >= 0.999, max_rel_err <= 1e-2 (eps=1e-6), pcc >= 0.99.

cosine.description: Cosine similarity to the golden (>= 0.999 to pass).

max_rel_err.description: Max relative error (<= 1e-2 to pass, eps=1e-6).
